text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Japanese Derby fast approaching, 
Mejiro Ardan pushed herself with 
unprecedented intensity, nearly collapsing 
from the strain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was certain that, as she was "now," 
she wouldn't be able to defeat Sakura 
Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki in the Nippon 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To defeat the two of them and fulfill her 
wish, Mejiro Ardan yearns to push past the 
limits of who she is "now."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to uphold the line as a 
Trainer, they resolved to hone their craft 
alongside Mejiro Ardan to the absolute 
limit.
